hints.tr: `chown` olmazsa program `unable to open database file` ile düşer: boş volume klasörün imajdaki sahibini alıyor.
hints.en: Without `chown` the program fails with `unable to open database file`: an empty volume takes the folder's owner in the image.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**Dockerfile**

```dockerfile
FROM python:3.13-slim

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    DB_PATH=/data/notes.db

RUN useradd --create-home --uid 1000 app \
 && mkdir /data \
 && chown app:app /data

WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY app.py healthcheck.py ./

USER app
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["python", "app.py"]
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

**Dockerfile**

```dockerfile
FROM python:3.13-slim

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    DB_PATH=/data/notes.db

RUN useradd --create-home --uid 1000 app \
 && mkdir /data \
 && chown app:app /data

WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY app.py healthcheck.py ./

USER app
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["python", "app.py"]
```
